_note: Difficulty (F-014, T-122): chosen for a new game and saved with it, never changed later. Each level multiplies the game's numbers at the start of the game (src/sim/difficulty.ts rescales the data in place, from the values in the other data files); normal is all 1, today's game. Knobs: startingStock (the landing stock); buildCost (rooms, corridors, linings and floors, bulkheads, windows, the shaft dome); buildTime (building hours of rooms, corridors, linings and the dome); digTime (the drill's floors and excavating a room's rock); decay (rooms' wear per day); health (health lost to unmet needs, poor sanitation and bad air); happiness (everyone's base happiness); hazards (dust storms and breakdowns, how often); eventSeverity (what an event's bad outcomes cost: lost resources, low mood, wear); unlocks (the population a hole needs for each unlock); deadlines (how long an event waits for an answer; later, F-011's move-out); rescue (the chance Earth sends colonists to a dwindling hole). Rough first values; T-125 tunes them by playing.

levels.name: Easy
levels.hint: New to the game or to city builders: more to start with, cheaper and quicker building, gentler setbacks. Turns on the guided tutorial.

levels.name: Hard
levels.hint: For a challenge: less to start with, dearer and slower building, rooms wear faster, harsher setbacks, and no help from Earth when a hole dwindles.
